description.from: Add the supported runtime and agent hook, typed envelopes, retry handling, usage propagation, and outside-in tests.
description.to: Harden the supported optional model-attempt authority contract: terminal unknown outcomes, replay-stable logical-call identity, post-contact non-retryable settlement behavior, and physical provider request input-token enforcement. Add outside-in regression coverage and focused validation. Policy, pricing, persistence, and product integrations are out of scope.
